title: GDAL metadata
description: Metadata that the GDAL library writes in the files it creates, undeclared and recognised from its keys: in TIFF the GDAL_NODATA and GDAL_METADATA tags (https://gdal.org/en/stable/drivers/raster/gtiff.html) and the structural metadata of Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs (https://gdal.org/en/stable/drivers/raster/cog.html); in netCDF and Zarr the georeferencing attributes of grid mapping variables, also written by rioxarray. Unofficial JSON Schema authored by hamk-uas/stac-schema-explorer to document and check metadata embedded in data files; it is not published or endorsed by the maintainers of the format or convention.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Attributes of a netCDF or Zarr variable.

spatial_ref.title: Spatial reference (WKT)
spatial_ref.description: CRS of the grid mapping variable as Well-Known Text, for GDAL; usually the same as CF `crs_wkt`.

GeoTransform.title: Geotransform
GeoTransform.description: Affine transform of the grid as six numbers separated by spaces, in GDAL order: x of the upper-left corner, pixel width, row rotation, y of the upper-left corner, column rotation, pixel height (negative for north-up).

_CRS.title: CRS (GDAL Zarr driver)
_CRS.description: CRS of a Zarr array written by GDAL's Zarr driver, as WKT, PROJJSON or a URL.

GDAL_NODATA.title: Nodata value
GDAL_NODATA.description: Value of pixels without data, as text, for all bands. Tag 42113.

gdal_metadata.title: GDAL metadata
gdal_metadata.description: Items of the GDAL_METADATA tag (42112), decoded from its XML. Items of the default domain have their name as key; items of another domain are keyed `domain:name`.

dataset.title: Dataset items
dataset.description: Items that apply to the whole image.

AREA_OR_POINT.title: Area or point
AREA_OR_POINT.description: Whether pixel values represent areas or points (dataset item).

SCALE.title: Scale
SCALE.description: Multiplier from stored to physical values (band item with role `scale`).

OFFSET.title: Offset
OFFSET.description: Added to scaled values to get physical values (band item with role `offset`).

UNITTYPE.title: Unit
UNITTYPE.description: Unit of the band values (band item with role `unittype`).

DESCRIPTION.title: Description
DESCRIPTION.description: Description of the band (band item with role `description`).

STATISTICS_MINIMUM.title: Minimum
STATISTICS_MINIMUM.description: Smallest value of the band computed by GDAL.

STATISTICS_MAXIMUM.title: Maximum
STATISTICS_MAXIMUM.description: Largest value of the band computed by GDAL.

STATISTICS_MEAN.title: Mean
STATISTICS_MEAN.description: Mean value of the band computed by GDAL.

STATISTICS_STDDEV.title: Standard deviation
STATISTICS_STDDEV.description: Standard deviation of the band values computed by GDAL.

STATISTICS_VALID_PERCENT.title: Valid percentage
STATISTICS_VALID_PERCENT.description: Percentage of valid (not nodata) pixels computed by GDAL.

bands.description: Items of each band (sample), from the first band.

gdal_structural_metadata.title: Structural metadata
gdal_structural_metadata.description: Layout declared in the header of a file written by GDAL's COG driver, which lets readers find tiles with few range requests.

LAYOUT.title: Layout
LAYOUT.description: `IFDS_BEFORE_DATA` when all image directories precede the image data, as in a COG.

BLOCK_ORDER.title: Block order
BLOCK_ORDER.description: Order of the tiles in the file, such as `ROW_MAJOR`.

BLOCK_LEADER.title: Block leader
BLOCK_LEADER.description: `SIZE_AS_UINT4` when each tile is preceded by its size.

BLOCK_TRAILER.title: Block trailer
BLOCK_TRAILER.description: `LAST_4_BYTES_REPEATED` when the last bytes of each tile are repeated after it.

KNOWN_INCOMPATIBLE_EDITION.title: Known incompatible edition
KNOWN_INCOMPATIBLE_EDITION.description: `YES` when the file was edited in a way that broke the layout.

MASK_INTERLEAVED_WITH_IMAGERY.title: Mask interleaved with imagery
MASK_INTERLEAVED_WITH_IMAGERY.description: `YES` when mask tiles follow their image tiles.
